clue.text: "Fundamental to include soil in variety of muck" in notes not really picked up

indicators.note: one word taking in another holds it inside its own letters
the earth word sits inside the shuffled letters of the next word
a variety is a different form, so the letters of the dirty word take a new order

blocks.note: basic means fundamental
taken as written, to be rearranged
ground is soil or earth

explanation.surface: A quoted phrase describing a gardener's recipe, followed by notes that were barely heard.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted sentence reads like a definition in its own right, but it is all wordplay, nested two layers deep; only the words after it define.
explanation.definitionFit: Background music is played quietly so that listeners do not really attend to it, hence notes barely noticed.

clue.text: Transport route a source of misery after American line invested

indicators.note: to invest something is to wrap or surround it, so the other pieces go inside

blocks.note: a bane is a cause of distress
US is short for American
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: An American traffic lane is complained about as the cause of commuters' misery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Invested' is used in its old sense of clothed or surrounded, not the financial one.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus lane is a road lane reserved for buses, so it is a route used by public transport.

clue.text: Shore/ drift

blocks.note: first meaning: the land beside the sea
second meaning: to move along without effort or power

explanation.walkthrough: Two separate meanings of one short word: a noun for the seaside and a verb for freewheeling.
explanation.definitionFit: The coast is the seashore, and to coast is to glide along without effort, as a cyclist does downhill.

clue.text: Good to get experienced Conservative — others getting the bird

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
old as in old hand, seasoned
C is the abbreviation for Conservative
the rest means the others

explanation.surface: A party's veteran Conservative gets heckled while colleagues are booed off too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting the bird' in the surface is the idiom for being jeered; here it simply leads to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The goldcrest is a tiny European songbird with a golden stripe on its crown.

clue.text: Elderly person keeping heritage body readily available

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it within, so one piece sits inside the other

blocks.note: OAP stands for old-age pensioner
NT is the National Trust, the British conservation charity

explanation.surface: A pensioner volunteers for a heritage organisation and is always on hand to help.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust is the British charity that looks after historic houses and land; an OAP is an old-age pensioner.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer on tap flows straight from the barrel, so the idiom means ready to use whenever wanted.

clue.text: Interpose — and again, after reflection?

indicators.note: a reflection is a mirror image, so the word must survive being read from the other end

blocks.note: the definition's word comes back a second time, this time read in mirror image, and is unchanged

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to interrupt again after thinking it over.
explanation.walkthrough: Reflection here means mirroring, not pondering: NIP IN reads the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To nip in is to slip quickly into a gap or a conversation, which is to interpose.

clue.text: Male just lacking initial strength

indicators.note: lacking its initial means the word loses its first letter

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for male
right means just or fair

explanation.surface: A man who is only short of some starting strength.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just' looks like 'only' but is the adjective meaning fair, giving RIGHT, which loses its R.
explanation.definitionFit: Might is power or force, as in 'with all his might', a synonym of strength.

clue.text: Is confused with manilla envelope's content?

definitions.text: Is confused with manilla envelope's content?

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up, so these are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something gets mixed up with whatever is inside a brown paper envelope.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: a manilla envelope is the buff paper kind that letters are posted in.
explanation.definitionFit: Snail mail is the jokey name for letters sent by post, which is what fills a manilla envelope.

clue.text: About to discuss retaining women's fashion show location

indicators.note: retaining means holding on to, so one letter is kept inside the word

blocks.note: ca is circa, Latin for about
to talk is to discuss
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: Gossip about where a women's fashion show is taking place.
explanation.definitionFit: A catwalk is the raised runway along which models parade at a fashion show.

clue.text: Sign of wound, granted, displays colour of blood

blocks.note: a scar is the mark a wound leaves
let means allowed or granted

explanation.surface: A wound mark that is given leave to show its blood-red colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet is a brilliant red, the shade associated with fresh blood.

clue.text: Show insect behind leaf

indicators.note: behind says the creature comes after the other piece in the line-up

blocks.note: a leaf of a book is a page
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: An instruction to point out a bug lurking behind a leaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show' looks like a verb but is a noun here, and 'leaf' is a sheet of paper, not foliage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageant is a public spectacle or procession, a type of show.

clue.text: Lorry's freezing, though not cold at first showing

indicators.note: not means the named letter is left out of the word

blocks.note: arctic means bitterly cold
C is cold, and only its first appearance in the word is removed

explanation.surface: A truck driver complains it is freezing, though it did not feel cold at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: ARCTIC has two Cs; 'at first showing' says only the first goes. Artic is British slang for an articulated lorry, an articulated truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Artic is the British informal shortening of articulated lorry, a large truck with a separate cab and trailer.

clue.text: Sort of cap covering a new cigar

indicators.note: covering something means going around it, so the short pieces sit inside

blocks.note: the patella is the kneecap
taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A new cigar is given a kind of cap, like the band around its end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort of cap' points to headgear but means the kneecap, the bone called the patella.
explanation.definitionFit: A panatella is a long thin cigar, so the word names a particular kind of cigar.

clue.text: Georgian city computer network in time repeatedly linking both sides of Asia

indicators.note: in places the network term inside the pair of time letters
both sides of a word are its two outermost letters

blocks.note: T is time, given twice
a LAN is a local area network
the first and last letters of the continent's name

explanation.surface: A US city with a computer network that keeps linking up both ends of Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: T, LAN, T is the bridge 'linking' the two outer A letters of Asia. 'Georgian' means the US state, not the country in the Caucasus.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is the capital and largest city of the US state of Georgia.

clue.text: Holiday from Orient Express terminus

indicators.note: to express is to squeeze out, so the end of the word is pushed off

blocks.note: orient as an adjective means eastern

explanation.surface: A holiday trip on the famous Orient Express to the end of the line.
explanation.walkthrough: The Orient Express train is a decoy: 'express' is the verb meaning squeeze out, so EASTERN loses its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter is the Christian festival that also gives a public holiday weekend in many countries.

clue.text: Special grant shared between us for brilliant show

blocks.note: SP is the abbreviation for special
to lend is to grant temporarily
our describes what belongs to us jointly

explanation.surface: A special grant split between two parties funds a dazzling performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Splendour is magnificence or grandeur, an impressive and brilliant display.

clue.text: What navigator's looking to secure maiden voyage in this?

blocks.note: to land a deal is to secure it
M is the abbreviation for maiden, an over without runs in cricket
Noah's famous voyage was made in an ark

explanation.surface: A sailor plans to secure a first voyage on a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maiden voyage' is a red herring: maiden gives M, and the rest of the clue cryptically describes a vessel, Noah's ark.
explanation.definitionFit: A landmark is a prominent feature that a navigator watches for in order to fix position.

clue.text: Quantity of coffee is steamed badly

indicators.note: done badly means put together wrongly, so these letters are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A complaint that the coffee has been poorly steamed.
explanation.definitionFit: A demitasse is a small cup for strong coffee, or the amount it holds.

clue.text: Explanation accordingly provided by corruption politician overlooked

indicators.note: something overlooked is missed out, so that word is dropped

blocks.note: so means therefore or accordingly
pollution is contamination or corruption
pol is short for politician

explanation.surface: An account of how a politician's corruption was conveniently ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: A solution is the answer to a problem, the thing that explains or resolves it.

clue.text: Win after spending hours in what game?

indicators.note: spending something uses it up, so those letters are gone

blocks.note: H is the abbreviation for hour, plural so two of them
as in an exclamation: what a game, such a game
chess is a game

explanation.surface: After hours of play, someone asks what game they finally won.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What game?' becomes SUCH CHESS (an exclamation, not a question), and both Hs are spent.
explanation.definitionFit: A success is a triumph or victory, the noun sense of a win.

clue.text: Charm stubborn person into returning thanks

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the letters run backwards
into places the stubborn creature inside the other piece

blocks.note: ta is British informal for thanks
a mule is an obstinate person

explanation.surface: Charm a pigheaded person into giving thanks in return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charm' looks like a verb but is the noun; ta is British slang for thank you.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a charm worn as protection against evil, a lucky trinket.

clue.text: Tune: primarily audiovisual artist's medium

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter is used

blocks.note: to temper an instrument is to tune it
the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A tune with an audiovisual element is an artist's chosen medium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tune' is a verb here: tempering is adjusting the tuning of an instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempera is paint made by binding pigment in egg yolk, a medium used by painters.

clue.text: Plane leaving Spain no later than one's agreed

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so that country's letter goes

blocks.note: Concorde was the supersonic airliner
E is the international vehicle code for Spain
as in arrive at six, by that time

explanation.surface: A plane leaves Spain no later than the time agreed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's agreed' means one that is agreed, a noun for an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A concordat is a formal agreement, especially a treaty between the Vatican and a state.

clue.text: Heavenly figure's prayer neglecting son

indicators.note: neglecting means ignoring, so that letter is left out

blocks.note: an orison is an old word for a prayer
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: An angel's prayer forgets to mention the son.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is a constellation pictured as a hunter, so it is a figure in the sky.

clue.text: Wild creature's roar and energy

blocks.note: a din is a loud noise
go means vigour or energy

explanation.surface: A wild animal's roaring and vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is the wild dog of Australia, a feral animal.

clue.text: Best reserve missing second part of season — that's the issue

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so the stated letter is absent

blocks.note: top means best
ice is coolness or reserve of manner
the second letter of the word

explanation.surface: The best reserve player sits out the second half of the season, and that's the problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserve' suggests a substitute player but means aloofness, as in icy manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject under discussion, which is an issue in that sense.

clue.text: Tribal symbol as those people envisage it? Not hard

indicators.note: not means without, so the following letter is removed

blocks.note: to them means in their view
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A question about how a tribe sees its emblem, which is not difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an object or animal adopted as an emblem by a tribe or clan.

clue.text: I wanted something additional to eat and something additional to drink

definitions.text: I wanted something additional to eat

blocks.clueFragment: I wanted something additional to eat
blocks.note: first meaning: Dickens's orphan who famously asked for more gruel
second meaning: a curl of citrus peel added to a cocktail

explanation.walkthrough: 'I' is the speaker Oliver, the boy in Dickens who asked 'Please, sir, I want some more.'
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver Twist begged for more food, and a twist of lemon is a garnish added to a drink.

clue.text: Commotion about soldiers backing attrition

indicators.note: about means around, so the first word wraps the troops
backing means moving backwards, so the result is read from the end

blocks.note: noise is racket or commotion
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A row about troops supporting a war of attrition.
explanation.definitionFit: Attrition is gradual wearing away by friction, just as erosion is.

clue.text: Long to take on board science of fish

indicators.note: taking on board means bringing aboard, so one piece goes inside

blocks.note: to pine is to long for
SCI is short for science

explanation.surface: A yearning to absorb the science of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Piscine is the adjective from the Latin piscis, relating to fish.

clue.text: Charts restoring Rotten's band

indicators.note: rotten means spoiled, so these letters go bad and fall into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The charts revive the Sex Pistols, the band of Johnny Rotten.
explanation.walkthrough: Rotten looks like Johnny Rotten of the Sex Pistols, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A string orchestra is an ensemble of violins, violas, cellos and basses, a band in the broad sense.
